A_live_crosscheck.caliper: CPU wall around ONE planner scatter_add call (v2 frozen)

B_signals_per_window.note: headroom + clone + det.sum already inside the protocol timing; excluded here to avoid double counting. Exposed once per W forwards on the scheduler thread (blocking).

C_protocol_timing_from_fault_tests.note: window protocol (3 collectives + step/hash + sync), per rank, 8xH20 nccl fault-test --timing; two independent runs reported, none cherry-picked
